session.title: Owen routing check; user-b.zhang Codex sign-out diagnosed and re-signed; switchy_account_signin skill
session.purpose: Check Owen's UK proxy routing, find why a Codex account signed out, sign it back in from its own AdsPower identity, and document that workflow as a skill with strict identity separation.
outcomes: Checked Owen's routing: Owen Hartley UK (98e00f12) was the selected Claude account; Switchy's five-minute exit checks all reported api.anthropic.com leaving as GB 82.26.163.142, Claude Code's CONNECT traffic used socks5://82.26.163.142:45001, and the last hour had 290 HTTP 200 and 24 Anthropic 429s with no 502s.

Diagnosed the user-b.zhang Codex sign-out (f7649e3f): OpenAI revoked it at 06:33 (token_revoked, then refresh_token_invalidated) right after a ChatGPT password reset run that morning (sign-in alert 06:29 LA, reset code 06:30:54, per Mailroom). Switchy had not touched the login. The laptop's Switchy holds a separate copy of this login that has been dead since 2026-10-11 and is marked as needing a new sign-in; that machine needs its own sign-in.

Re-signed f7649e3f at 08:19 from AdsPower profile 12 via plain Windows codex login. That run also opened the auth link in the user's everyday Chrome (default browser): Windows Codex ignores BROWSER and the agent shell does not load Switchy's device-code wrapper. Nothing was approved in that tab; the user was asked to close it.

A WSL codex login probe at 12:04:50 (the tool call was rejected but had already run) revoked the fresh login: starting codex login signs out the install's current login, and Switchy mirrors the current account into WSL. Re-signed again at 12:12 with Switchy switched to f7649e3f (both auth.json files absent), plain codex login inside WSL with BROWSER=/usr/bin/true (MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 from Git Bash), the normal auth link opened only in profile 12 after its exit read 108.235.194.164 US; profile 12 reached WSL's 127.0.0.1:1455 callback directly. Verified: Successfully logged in, Switchy reset the breaker, card and Windows auth.json carry user-b.zhang issued 12:12:29, f7649e3f current. Tab closed, profile disconnected.

Wrote the switchy_account_signin skill (Claude Code and Codex, Windows and WSL; four copies hash-identical): switch Switchy to the account, start the login with no local browser, open the link only in the account's mapped profile after an email and exit check, finish every login that is started, confirm Switchy stored it, clean up. The Claude path (claude auth login with Switchy's no-op BROWSER, account switched first so the code exchange leaves through its own proxy, then Capture login) is written but not yet exercised.

Recorded the account-to-sign-in-profile map in system-setup/browser_identity_plan.md (hub ad805e0, d0538f8): Codex user-b.zhang -> AdsPower 12; Claude Owen -> AdsPower 18 with Switchy proxy = profile 18's exit; registered2nd (Codex and Claude) -> regular Chrome (Private identity). yt453218073 (another user's Gmail) and the Apple relay 87zbk6gyx7 have no recorded sign-in browser and remain marked not assigned; the user has not yet said which. Recorded the agent-shell Codex sign-in behaviour in agent_environment_operations.md § CLI sign-in (d0538f8). An accounts.md edit was reverted at the user's direction.
session.latest_summary: Owen confirmed on its UK exit. user-b.zhang's Codex login, revoked by a password reset and then by an agent's abandoned WSL login, re-signed from AdsPower profile 12 via WSL codex login; switchy_account_signin skill and the account-to-profile map recorded.

current_focus.summary: Switchy 1.0.34 is the latest public Windows and Apple Silicon release and is installed on the workstation. A login renewal that cannot reach the sign-in service now reports a retryable connection error rather than asking for /login. The requested fix and release are complete; await the user's feedback. Prior renewal, restart, WSL, rotation and proxy-off checks remain pending under their triggers. The macOS build was not run on a Mac.

next_actions.summary: Confirm account-proxy coverage on the next natural Claude sign-in or renewal while Owen is selected, without forcing a new login. Claude Code's own exchange should log '[connect_tunnel] platform.claude.com:443 via socks5://82.26.163.142:45001'. For Switchy's renewal, observe '[claude_pool] refreshing login for provider=98e00f12...' and the successful refreshed-login message; the enforced per-account client route is owned by proxy/http_client.rs. Windows/WSL HTTPS_PROXY and NO_PROXY, UK exit probes and telemetry tunnels were verified; a live sign-in/renewal using this route remains unobserved. Connection failures must stop rather than fall back to direct; country observations only warn.

CONFIRM THE RESTART PATH ON STEPHEN'S NEXT WINDOWS RESTART (1.0.29). In C:/Users/Administrator/.switchy/logs/switchy.prev.log after 'Session ending; handing the live configs back': '[session-end] claude/codex/gemini handed back', '[session-end] ... in WSL handed back', then 'Live configs handed back for the session end'. 'did not finish in 4 seconds' with the last [session-end] line shows which step stalls (Windows step = database lock, WSL step = WSL I/O); fix that step. In switchy.log: Switchy started within seconds of login (window hidden, launched with --autostart from HKCU Run), '[auto_launch] start at login on', proxy on 15721, and Claude Code / Codex answer without ECONNREFUSED.

CONFIRM CLAUDE LOGINS STAY IN STEP WITH WSL (1.0.27). In switchy.log, when an account WSL is signed in to renews: '[claude_pool] provider=... took the newer login from WSL' or 'wrote the refreshed login through to WSL', and no new 'invalid_grant' 'Refresh token not found or invalid' in account_switches/provider_health. WSL's ~/.claude/.credentials.json and ~/.switchy/accounts/<id>/credentials.json for that account should carry the same refreshToken after each renewal.

CONFIRM ROTATION AND CODEX FAILOVER ON LIVE TRAFFIC (1.0.25/1.0.26). In C:/Users/Administrator/.switchy/logs/switchy.log and the switchy.db account_switches table: (a) when an account's five-hour window resets while another serves, a switch back to it with reason 'recovered' and detail "Another account's weekly limit resets sooner"; (b) a Codex turn refused for usage that continues an earlier one logs '[CodexWS] provider=... websocket closed (turn refused for usage; Codex resends it in full)' and the turn then completes on the next account with no error in Codex. GET http://127.0.0.1:15721/switchy/accounts shows current account, pool order, quota and atLimit per account.

VERIFY LOCAL PROXY OFF WITH AN OPEN CODEX WINDOW. the user was asked to turn Local proxy off in Settings > Pool, then use a Codex window opened while the proxy was on. Confirm in C:/Users/Administrator/.switchy/logs/switchy.log that "Proxy turned off; its listener stays up..." was logged, that the Codex window's later [Codex] requests still reached the proxy and answered, that netstat shows 127.0.0.1:15721 still LISTENING, and that Settings shows the proxy as off. Turning it back on must reuse the listener.

QUIT CASE WAITS ON STEPHEN. Quitting Switchy still breaks Codex windows opened under the proxy. He was offered a warning on quit naming the open Codex windows (small) or running the proxy as a process that outlives Switchy's window (large); he has not chosen. Build nothing until he does.
If the user directs request logging to be enabled, first make the Usage page's Turn on button apply to the running proxy, then enable it for Claude, Codex, and Gemini.
